scientific_integrity: The exact positive-sum proof excludes all nonconstant fixed-sphere periodic trajectories under the specified mixture hypothesis. A delayed nonnegative counterexample is verified algebraically; no independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-radius periodic motions are excluded, not all recurrent motions.
The witness establishes existence of circular orbits, not orbital stability.
Broader historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Spherical periodic-motion obstruction for passive memory and an exact delayed-kernel circle
